18-Day Grand Turkey & Greece: Islands & Ancient Lands
summary:
The 18-Day Turkey & Greece Tour builds a longer two-country journey around inland Turkey and an extended Greek island route. Begin in Istanbul before continuing to Cappadocia and Pamukkale, then transition into the island portion through Rhodes and Crete. From there, travel through the Cyclades with stays in Santorini and Mykonos before finishing in Athens. Including both Rhodes and Crete gives the Greek section a broader geographic range than itineraries focused only on the Cycladic islands.
Eighteen days allow the route to combine guided sightseeing with independent time between destinations. Selected 4-star hotels, daily breakfast, English-speaking local guides, domestic flights, Greek ferries, airport and port transfers and scheduled sightseeing are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise & Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable Bosphorus cruise, sailing between Europe and Asia along one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, transfer to the airport at 15:00 for your flight to Nevsehir at 18:45. Upon arrival at 20:10, and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle for panoramic views, followed by Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum, famous for fairy chimneys and cave dwellings. After lunch, continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit the charming towns of Urgup and Avanos, known for traditional pottery. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia & Flight to Izmirir
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, the former Greek village of Mustafapaşa, and the Roman ruins of Sobesos Ancient City. Continue to Soğanlı Valley for a scenic walk through its cave churches, followed by lunch. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City, one of Cappadocia’s most famous underground settlements. After the tour, transfer to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Izmir at 22:50. Upon arrival at 00:20, meet and transfer to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Ephesus tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a guided tour of Ephesus, visiting highlights such as the Odeon, Library of Celsus, Temple of Hadrian, Fountain of Trajan, and the Great Theatre. Continue to the ruins of the Temple of Artemis, followed by lunch and a visit to the House of the Virgin Mary. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Day trip to Pamukkale & Hierapolis
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also enjoy swimming at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, drive back to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Rhodes
itinerary.text:
Transfer from Kusadasi to Marmaris Port for ferry check-in and customs procedures. Ferry to Rhodes.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and enjoy free time at leisure. Overnight in Rhodes.

itinerary.title: Free day in Rhodes
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a full day at leisure in Rhodes to explore the historic Old Town, relax on the beaches, or visit the picturesque village of Lindos. Overnight in Rhodes.

itinerary.title: Flight to Heraklion
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel, then transfer to Rhodes International Airport for your flight to Heraklion.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Evening at leisure. Overnight in Heraklion.

itinerary.title: Free day in Heraklion
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free day at leisure in Heraklion.
Optional visits to the Palace of Knossos and the Heraklion Archaeological Museum are available.
Overnight in Heraklion.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel, then transfer to the port in Heraklion for your ferry to Santorini.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel.
The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Free day in Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a free day at leisure in Santorini to relax on the beaches or explore the charming town of Fira.
Optional bus or boat excursions to the volcano and ancient ruins are available.
Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Mykonos
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel, then transfer to the port in Santorini for your ferry to Mykonos.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Free day in Mykonos
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free day to explore Mykonos at your own pace. Wander through the charming whitewashed streets of Mykonos Town, discover boutique shops, waterfront cafés, and local restaurants, or relax on one of the island’s beautiful beaches. In the evening, enjoy the lively atmosphere and famous nightlife that Mykonos is known for. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Athens
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel, then transfer to the port in Mykonos for your ferry to Port of Piraeus.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel in Athens. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens City Tour
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a half-day city tour of Athens, including the Acropolis of Athens, Parthenon, and Acropolis Museum. Continue past the Parliament, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Presidential Palace, Panathenaic Stadium, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Arch of Hadrian. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Departure from Athens
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Athens Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 18-Day Turkey and Greece Tour?
faqs.a: The 18-Day Turkey and Greece Tour covers Istanbul, Cappadocia, Kusadasi, Pamukkale, Rhodes, Crete, Athens, Mykonos, and Santorini. You will explore Turkey's most famous historical and natural attractions before continuing to Greece's iconic islands and mainland highlights. The tour combines ancient history, stunning landscapes, beautiful beaches, and vibrant local culture over 17 nights and 18 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 18-Day Turkey and Greece Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from 4,295 euros per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, domestic flights within Turkey, ferry tickets between Greece and Turkey as well as the Greek islands, guided tours, entrance fees, selected meals, and all airport, hotel, and port transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel availability.

faqs.q: Are flights and ferry tickets included in this 18-day itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes domestic flights within Turkey and all ferry tickets required by the itinerary. Ferry routes connect Turkey with Rhodes and continue between Crete, Athens, Mykonos, and Santorini, providing a comfortable and scenic way to travel across the Aegean Sea.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 17 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations near major attractions, ports, and city centers. All airport, hotel, and port transfers are included.

faqs.q: Does the 18-day Turkey and Greece tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guides provide historical background, cultural insights, and local expertise while ensuring a smooth and enjoyable travel experience throughout Turkey and Greece.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey and Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors seeking a comprehensive introduction to both countries. It combines Turkey's cultural treasures with Greece's mainland highlights and famous islands, offering an excellent balance of history, archaeology, scenery, and leisure time.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the 18-day tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic towns, island villages, and areas with uneven surfaces, including Ephesus, Pamukkale, the Acropolis, Rhodes Old Town, and Cappadocia. Most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: Can I add a hot air balloon ride in Cappadocia?
faqs.a: The Cappadocia hot air balloon ride is not included in the standard package but can be arranged as an optional activity. Since balloon flights are weather-dependent and highly popular, advance booking is strongly recommended to secure availability.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Turkey and Greece Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 18-Day Turkey and Greece Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: The tour operates during the ferry season and can be customized according to your travel preferences. You can extend your stay in any destination, upgrade hotel categories, add optional excursions, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
